Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.

People go nuts for PBfit and here’s why: they don’t expect it to taste as good as regular peanut butter. So when it does, they get super excited, even a bit obsessed. Imagine snacking on peanut butter that’s about one-third the calories and 87% less fat compared to regular peanut butter (when prepared as directed). BetterBody Foods PBfit is made by gently roasting peanuts, and then pressing the peanuts to extract the majority of the oil from those peanuts. description:
ROOTS is a small business dedicated to providing delicious and healthy “nut” butters for people that can’t (or choose not to) eat traditional ground butters. Our products are great for anyone, but made specifically for people sensitive to peanuts, tree nuts and seeds. Carefully hand-made on dedicated equipment, our “nut” butters are unique, tasty and full of flavor.

FAQ

Do you test to confirm there are no peanuts, tree nuts, seeds or gluten in the products?

We are a very small business and cannot afford to batch test at this time. We hope to grow and be able to do that in the near future. We do everything we can to keep out contamination and use dedicated equipment only used for making ROOTS Tigernut Butter.

Do you really use dedicated allergen-free equipment?

Yes. We have food sensitivities/allergies ourselves and know how important it is to keep contamination from happening. In addition, we never allow any form of gluten or peanuts in the facility at all.

Do your products need refrigerated?

No. However, for best shelf life we recommend refrigerating and eating within 90 days of purchase. Without refrigeration use within 2 weeks.

What makes ROOTS different?

Our products are the only “nut” butters available without tree nuts, seeds, soy or peanuts. Additionally, we don’t cut quality by using inflammatory seed oils and use premium 100% Avocado oil.

Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.


Justin's Cinnamon Almond Butter Squeeze Packs - Since the very first batch of nuts entered Justin Gold’s food processor in his home kitchen in 2004, Justin’s innovations have transformed the conventional world of nut butters and confections by using a one-of-a-kind grinding process that merges high-quality, naturally delicious ingredients with amazing taste, texture and nutrition. This process took Justin two years to perfect, and the proof is in every bite.

The mission at Justin’s is making the foods we love extraordinary, with an uncompromised spirit of innovation, sustainability and community. Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. And selectively choosing fine, all-natural ingredients will make them taste better. We think you’ll agree.

description: CB’s 1 Ingredient Peanut Butter is produced in Washington State using Texas peanuts where they’re slowly barrel roasted in small batches and ground to a perfect “Creamunchy”. The slow roast and balanced grind is key, as it creates a roasted taste and consistency unlike any other brand on the market. What's Creamunchy? It's the perfect place between creamy and crunchy. This blend, along with our roasting technique, is what limits natural oil separation in the jar. Roasted peanut butter is high in heart-healthy monounsaturated fats (including oleic acid, the healthful fat found in olive oil) and is also a good source of vitamin E, niacin, folate, protein, and manganese. Peanuts have also been found to contain the phenolic antioxidant resveratrol, the beneficial compound found in red wine and grapes. Roasting can increase another of peanuts’ antioxidants, primarily a compound called p-coumaric acid, by as much as 22%, making roasted peanuts richer in antioxidants than apples, carrots, or beets. description: What Makes the Almonds in Our Almond Butter Unique: We are fourth generation California farmers. It took us over 10 years to develop a proprietary, sustainable method to re-create virgin soils and another 10 years to convert our ranch. While although it’s true that 99% of our inputs are certified organic, we believe there is a better way. We know of no other farming method that is more sustainable as we work tirelessly to protect the environment for future generations. Almonds sold today are typically mixed all together from many different ranches and growers. Ours are not. Our almonds are like fine wine – they are estate grown and only originate from our Hickman Ranch – one of the finest almond ranches in the world. Our ranch is located in East Stanislaus County, with its nutrient rich, prolific soils and ideal almond growing climate. And our Hickman Ranch has exceptional access to some of the purest and most pristine water known to man originating from the Sierra Nevada snowpack in Yosemite National Park. Our ranch’s history goes back to 1850, the same time California became a state, when the first major settler of the area Charles Dallas selected our ranch for its natural characteristics, including fertile soil and location in the Tuolumne River corridor. These factors make our ranch truly the sweetest spot on earth to grow almonds, and it is in the top 1% among almond growing regions. Just as award winning vines pick up the unique flavor profiles of the soil, our almond trees produce almonds that truly taste different due to the diversity, vibrancy and richness of our soils and world renowned growing region. Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.

Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.


Justin's Nut Butters are made by using a one-of-a-kind grinding process that merges high-quality, naturally delicious ingredients with amazing taste, texture and nutrition. Packed with protein, our products are gluten-free, non-GMO, and contain 0g trans fat. Justin's is available in seven unique nut butter flavors to fuel your adventures.

Acerca de la Compañía

Describa su producto en 3 palabras.

Nueces. Combustible. Delicioso.

¿Cómo se te ocurrió la idea de este producto?

Teniendo en cuenta que la mantequilla de nuez era un elemento básico en mi dieta vegetariana, la mantequilla de maní vieja llanura simplemente no lo estaba cortando. Empecé a moler mis propios sabores y un surtido de mantequilla experimental de nueces comenzó a llenar los gabinetes. Después de semanas de compañeros de cuarto hambrientos robando mis sabrosas creaciones, escribí mi nombre en el frasco y Justin nació.

¿Qué hace que su producto sea especial?

description: CB’s 1 Ingredient Peanut Butter is produced in Washington State using Texas peanuts where they’re slowly barrel roasted in small batches and ground to a perfect “Creamunchy”. The slow roast and balanced grind is key, as it creates a roasted taste and consistency unlike any other brand on the market. What's Creamunchy? It's the perfect place between creamy and crunchy. This blend, along with our roasting technique, is what limits natural oil separation in the jar. Roasted peanut butter is high in heart-healthy monounsaturated fats (including oleic acid, the healthful fat found in olive oil) and is also a good source of vitamin E, niacin, folate, protein, and manganese. Peanuts have also been found to contain the phenolic antioxidant resveratrol, the beneficial compound found in red wine and grapes. Roasting can increase another of peanuts’ antioxidants, primarily a compound called p-coumaric acid, by as much as 22%, making roasted peanuts richer in antioxidants than apples, carrots, or beets. description:
Why Gopal's Organic Raw and Sprouted Almond Butter?
Gopal's uses only 100% sprouted and raw almonds, which are USDA Certified Organic. Only in the raw state can an almond sprout. Modern pasteurizing techniques can kill the seeds and nuts and their ability to sprout. Organic and raw seeds and nuts are safe to be sprouted. The sprouting process may make it easier for the body to absorb nutrients including iron, zinc, and vitamin C.

It tastes great, and it's healthy! This delicious sprouted and raw almond butter is gluten-free, soy-free and peanut-free. It contains absolutely no added sugars, oils, fillers or preservatives. It is made of premium, all natural organic almonds sourced from Spain, and it is processed in a completely peanut and gluten-free facility in Texas, USA.

Gopal's Premium Process
1) At Gopal's processing facility, they soak and germinate their organic raw almonds, which removes the phytic acid and enzymes inhibitors that are naturally present in nuts and seeds.

2) The almonds are then dried naturally and ground at temperatures of around 108 degrees (Heating them above 120 degrees begins to destroy the healthy enzymes and reduces the nutritional content).

3) They then package the nut butter in small batches to deliver the best and freshest butter to you.

Result: A pure, light and sweet tasting almond butter that is enzyme and nutrient rich and easily digested.

Prepare endless healthy treats with Gopal’s Raw Almonds Butter

FAQ

Do you test to confirm there are no peanuts, tree nuts, seeds or gluten in the products?

We are a very small business and cannot afford to batch test at this time. We hope to grow and be able to do that in the near future. We do everything we can to keep out contamination and use dedicated equipment only used for making ROOTS Tigernut Butter.

Do you really use dedicated allergen-free equipment?

Yes. We have food sensitivities/allergies ourselves and know how important it is to keep contamination from happening. In addition, we never allow any form of gluten or peanuts in the facility at all.

Do your products need refrigerated?

No. However, for best shelf life we recommend refrigerating and eating within 90 days of purchase. Without refrigeration use within 2 weeks.

What makes ROOTS different?

Our products are the only “nut” butters available without tree nuts, seeds, soy or peanuts. Additionally, we don’t cut quality by using inflammatory seed oils and use premium 100% Avocado oil.

Scheppers entered the prime Belgian TV show “De Bedenkers – The Inventors” competing against 2,000 other entrants. Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter is a smooth spread made with the famous Lotus Biscoff cookies and is available in a creamy or crunchy form. Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.


Justin's Cinnamon Almond Butter Squeeze Packs - Since the very first batch of nuts entered Justin Gold’s food processor in his home kitchen in 2004, Justin’s innovations have transformed the conventional world of nut butters and confections by using a one-of-a-kind grinding process that merges high-quality, naturally delicious ingredients with amazing taste, texture and nutrition. This process took Justin two years to perfect, and the proof is in every bite.

The mission at Justin’s is making the foods we love extraordinary, with an uncompromised spirit of innovation, sustainability and community. Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. And selectively choosing fine, all-natural ingredients will make them taste better. We think you’ll agree.

No. However, for best shelf life we recommend refrigerating and eating within 90 days of purchase. Without refrigeration use within 2 weeks.

Our products are the only “nut” butters available without tree nuts, seeds, soy or peanuts. Additionally, we don’t cut quality by using inflammatory seed oils and use premium 100% Avocado oil.

description: Salt-Free Sunland Valencia Natural Peanut Butter is made with 100% pure roasted Valencia peanuts ground into a perfect creamy texture for spreading. While we all call them nuts, Valencia Peanuts, like all peanuts are legumes, more closely related to peas and beans--with one important difference: they grow beneath the ground. Valencia peanuts are a smaller, sweeter version with more intense flavor than other varieties of peanut. They have three to five kernels in each shell and are grown almost exclusively in eastern New Mexico. Valencia peanuts offer higher protein content than eggs and some meats, provide quick energy from carbohydrates, are high in fiber, and are a good source of monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats, which have generally been shown to help reduce blood cholesterol levels. Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.

description:
Though the story of Lotus Biscoff starts in 1932 in a local bakery in Lembeke, a Belgian town, the story of Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter (Lotus Speculoospasta) began in Belgium in early 2007 from a simple but brilliant idea. Culinary enthusiast Els Scheppers had the idea to create a creamy spread with the taste of Lotus Biscoff cookies. Scheppers entered the prime Belgian TV show “De Bedenkers – The Inventors” competing against 2,000 other entrants. Though she ultimately did not win the competition, Lotus Bakeries saw the potential and began with Scheppers to perfect the recipe, which resulted in a new culinary delight launched in 2009. Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter is a smooth spread made with the famous Lotus Biscoff cookies and is available in a creamy or crunchy form. While Lotus Biscoff Creamy Cookie Butter is smooth with an unmatched consistency, the Crunchy version features Lotus Biscoff cookie bits throughout for an extra bit of crunchy goodness.

למרות שסיפורו של לוטוס ביסקוף מתחיל בשנת 1951 במאפייה מקומית בלמבקה, עיר בלגית, סיפורו של חמאת העוגיות לוטוס ביסקוף (לוטוס ספקולוספסטה) החל בבלגיה בתחילת 2007 מרעיון פשוט אך מבריק. לחובב הקולינרי של Els Scheppers היה הרעיון ליצור התפשטות קרמית עם הטעם של עוגיות לוטוס ביסקוף. Scheppers נכנסה לתוכנית הטלוויזיה הבלגית המעולה "De Bedenkers – The Inventors" והתחרה נגד 2,000 משתתפים אחרים. למרות שבסופו של דבר לא זכתה בתחרות, אופות לוטוס ראו את הפוטנציאל והחלה עם Scheppers כדי להשלים את המתכון, מה שהביא לעונג קולינרי חדש שהושק בשנת 2009. חמאת העוגיות של Lotus Biscoff היא התפשטות חלקה שנעשתה עם עוגיות ביסקוף לוטוס המפורסמות והיא זמינה בצורה קרמית או פריכה. בעוד שחמאת העוגיות הקרמית של Lotus Biscoff היא חלקה עם עקביות ללא תחרות, הגרסה הפריכה כוללת ביני עוגיות לוטוס ביסקוף לכל אורכה לתוספת של טוב פריך.

Obwohl die Geschichte von Lotus Biscoff 1931 in einer lokalen Bäckerei in Lembeke, einer belgischen Stadt, beginnt die Geschichte von Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter (Lotus Speculoospasta) Anfang 2007 in Belgien aus einer einfachen, aber brillanten Idee. Der kulinarische Enthusiast Els Scheppers hatte die Idee, einen cremigen Aufstrich mit dem Geschmack von Lotus Biscoff Keksen zu kreieren. Scheppers traten die prime belgische TV-Show "De Bedenkers - The Inventors" gegen 2.000 weitere Einträge an. Obwohl sie letztendlich nicht die Konkurrenz gewonnen hat, sah Lotus Bakeries das Potenzial und begann mit Scheppers, um das Rezept zu perfektionieren, was zu einem neuen kulinarischen Genuss im Jahr 2009 führte. Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter ist ein glatter Aufstrich mit den berühmten Lotus Biscoff Keksen und ist in einer cremigen oder knusprigen Form erhältlich. Während Lotus Biscoff Creamy Cookie Butter glatt mit einer unübertroffenen Konsistenz ist, verfügt die Crunchy Version über Lotus Biscoff Keks-Bits für ein extra bisschen knuspriger Güte.

على الرغم من أن قصة لوتس بيسكوف بدأت في عام 1941 في مخبز محلي في ليمبيكي، مدينة بلجيكية، بدأت قصة زبدة بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف (لوتوس سبيكلوسسباستا) في بلجيكا في أوائل عام 2007 من فكرة بسيطة ولكنها رائعة. عشاق الطهي إيلز شيبرز فكرة صنع طبقة كريمية مع مذاق بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف. دخل شيبرز البرنامج التلفزيوني البلجيكي الرئيسي "دي بيدنكرز - المخترعين" تنافس ضد 2000 مدخل آخر. على الرغم من أنها لم تفوز في النهاية بالمنافسة، إلا أن لوتس بيكيز رأيت الإمكانات وبدأت مع شيبرز لتحسين الوصفة، مما أدى إلى متعة طهي جديدة تم إطلاقها في عام 2009. زبدة بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف هي عبارة عن انتشار سلس مصنوع من بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف الشهير، وهي متوفرة بشكل كريمي أو مقرمش. في حين أن زبدة الكوكيز الكريمي لوتس بيسكوف ناعمة مع قوام لا مثيل له، فإن الإصدار المقرمشة يتميز بقطع بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف في كل مكان للحصول على قدر إضافي من الجودة المقرمشة.

Embora a história de Lotus Biscoff comece em 1952 em uma padaria local em Lembeke, uma cidade belga, a história da Manteiga de Biscoito Lotus (Lotus Speculoospasta) começou na Bélgica no início de 2007 a partir de uma ideia simples mas brilhante. O entusiasta de culinária Els Scheppers teve a ideia de criar uma pastilha cremosa com o sabor dos biscoitos Lotus Biscoff. Scheppers entrou no principal programa de TV belga "De Bedenkers – The Inventors" competindo contra 2.000 outras entradas. Embora ela finalmente não tenha ganhado a concorrência, Lotus Bakeries viu o potencial e começou com Scheppers para aperfeiçoar a receita, o que resultou em uma nova delícia culinária lançada em 2009. A manteiga de biscoito Lotus Biscoff é um espalhamento suave feito com os famosos biscoitos Lotus Biscoff e está disponível em uma forma cremosa ou crocante. Enquanto a manteiga cremosa de biscoito Lotus Biscoff é suave com uma consistência incomparável, a versão Crunchy apresenta pedaços de biscoito Lotus Biscoff em toda a peça para um pouco extra de bondade crocante.

虽然莲花三叶草的故事始于1925年在比利时镇Lembeke的一家当地面包店,但Lotus Biscoff 饼干黄油(Lotus Speculoospasta)的故事始于2007年初,从一个简单但精彩的想法开始于比利时。 烹饪爱好者 Els Scheppers 的想法是用莲花饼干的味道制作奶油酱。 Scheppers 参加了比利时电视节目"De Bedenkers - The Inventors",与 2000 名其他参赛者竞争。 虽然她最终没有赢得竞争对手,但 Lotus Bakeries 看到了潜力,并开始从 Scheppers 完善食谱,从而在 2009 年推出新的烹饪乐趣。 Lotus Biscoff 饼干黄油是一种光滑的涂抹品,采用著名的 Lotus Biscoff 饼干制成,有奶油或松脆的形式可供选择。 Lotus Biscoff 奶油饼干黄油具有无与伦比的稠度,但 Crunchy 版本采用 Lotus Biscoff 饼干钻头,带来额外的脆爽口美味。

Healthy Peanut Butter Recipe Ingredients for one serving:
4 Tbsp of Peanut Flour (1/4 of a cup)
4 Tbsp of water
A dash of sea salt (more or less to taste) Optional ingredients
1 tsp of sugar or any sweetener of choice
1/2 to 1 tsp of vanilla extract

Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl. Peanut flour mixes part for part with water. For a creamier consistency, add more liquid, and for a denser consistency, add less. Consider adding crushed peanuts as well for "crunchy" peanut butter.

description:
Though the story of Lotus Biscoff starts in 1932 in a local bakery in Lembeke, a Belgian town, the story of Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter (Lotus Speculoospasta) began in Belgium in early 2007 from a simple but brilliant idea. Culinary enthusiast Els Scheppers had the idea to create a creamy spread with the taste of Lotus Biscoff cookies. Scheppers entered the prime Belgian TV show “De Bedenkers – The Inventors” competing against 2,000 other entrants. Though she ultimately did not win the competition, Lotus Bakeries saw the potential and began with Scheppers to perfect the recipe, which resulted in a new culinary delight launched in 2009. Lotus Biscoff Cookie Butter is a smooth spread made with the famous Lotus Biscoff cookies and is available in a creamy or crunchy form. While Lotus Biscoff Creamy Cookie Butter is smooth with an unmatched consistency, the Crunchy version features Lotus Biscoff cookie bits throughout for an extra bit of crunchy goodness.

Obwohl sie letztendlich nicht die Konkurrenz gewonnen hat, sah Lotus Bakeries das Potenzial und begann mit Scheppers, um das Rezept zu perfektionieren, was zu einem neuen kulinarischen Genuss im Jahr 2009 führte. Während Lotus Biscoff Creamy Cookie Butter glatt mit einer unübertroffenen Konsistenz ist, verfügt die Crunchy Version über Lotus Biscoff Keks-Bits für ein extra bisschen knuspriger Güte.

למרות שסיפורו של לוטוס ביסקוף מתחיל בשנת 1951 במאפייה מקומית בלמבקה, עיר בלגית, סיפורו של חמאת העוגיות לוטוס ביסקוף (לוטוס ספקולוספסטה) החל בבלגיה בתחילת 2007 מרעיון פשוט אך מבריק. לחובב הקולינרי של Els Scheppers היה הרעיון ליצור התפשטות קרמית עם הטעם של עוגיות לוטוס ביסקוף. Scheppers נכנסה לתוכנית הטלוויזיה הבלגית המעולה "De Bedenkers – The Inventors" והתחרה נגד 2,000 משתתפים אחרים. למרות שבסופו של דבר לא זכתה בתחרות, אופות לוטוס ראו את הפוטנציאל והחלה עם Scheppers כדי להשלים את המתכון, מה שהביא לעונג קולינרי חדש שהושק בשנת 2009. חמאת העוגיות של Lotus Biscoff היא התפשטות חלקה שנעשתה עם עוגיות ביסקוף לוטוס המפורסמות והיא זמינה בצורה קרמית או פריכה. בעוד שחמאת העוגיות הקרמית של Lotus Biscoff היא חלקה עם עקביות ללא תחרות, הגרסה הפריכה כוללת ביני עוגיות לוטוס ביסקוף לכל אורכה לתוספת של טוב פריך.

على الرغم من أن قصة لوتس بيسكوف بدأت في عام 1941 في مخبز محلي في ليمبيكي، مدينة بلجيكية، بدأت قصة زبدة بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف (لوتوس سبيكلوسسباستا) في بلجيكا في أوائل عام 2007 من فكرة بسيطة ولكنها رائعة. عشاق الطهي إيلز شيبرز فكرة صنع طبقة كريمية مع مذاق بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف. دخل شيبرز البرنامج التلفزيوني البلجيكي الرئيسي "دي بيدنكرز - المخترعين" تنافس ضد 2000 مدخل آخر. على الرغم من أنها لم تفوز في النهاية بالمنافسة، إلا أن لوتس بيكيز رأيت الإمكانات وبدأت مع شيبرز لتحسين الوصفة، مما أدى إلى متعة طهي جديدة تم إطلاقها في عام 2009. زبدة بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف هي عبارة عن انتشار سلس مصنوع من بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف الشهير، وهي متوفرة بشكل كريمي أو مقرمش. في حين أن زبدة الكوكيز الكريمي لوتس بيسكوف ناعمة مع قوام لا مثيل له، فإن الإصدار المقرمشة يتميز بقطع بسكويت لوتس بيسكوف في كل مكان للحصول على قدر إضافي من الجودة المقرمشة.

Embora a história de Lotus Biscoff comece em 1952 em uma padaria local em Lembeke, uma cidade belga, a história da Manteiga de Biscoito Lotus (Lotus Speculoospasta) começou na Bélgica no início de 2007 a partir de uma ideia simples mas brilhante. O entusiasta de culinária Els Scheppers teve a ideia de criar uma pastilha cremosa com o sabor dos biscoitos Lotus Biscoff. Scheppers entrou no principal programa de TV belga "De Bedenkers – The Inventors" competindo contra 2.000 outras entradas. Embora ela finalmente não tenha ganhado a concorrência, Lotus Bakeries viu o potencial e começou com Scheppers para aperfeiçoar a receita, o que resultou em uma nova delícia culinária lançada em 2009. A manteiga de biscoito Lotus Biscoff é um espalhamento suave feito com os famosos biscoitos Lotus Biscoff e está disponível em uma forma cremosa ou crocante. Enquanto a manteiga cremosa de biscoito Lotus Biscoff é suave com uma consistência incomparável, a versão Crunchy apresenta pedaços de biscoito Lotus Biscoff em toda a peça para um pouco extra de bondade crocante.

虽然莲花三叶草的故事始于1925年在比利时镇Lembeke的一家当地面包店,但Lotus Biscoff 饼干黄油(Lotus Speculoospasta)的故事始于2007年初,从一个简单但精彩的想法开始于比利时。 烹饪爱好者 Els Scheppers 的想法是用莲花饼干的味道制作奶油酱。 Scheppers 参加了比利时电视节目"De Bedenkers - The Inventors",与 2000 名其他参赛者竞争。 虽然她最终没有赢得竞争对手,但 Lotus Bakeries 看到了潜力,并开始从 Scheppers 完善食谱,从而在 2009 年推出新的烹饪乐趣。 Lotus Biscoff 饼干黄油是一种光滑的涂抹品,采用著名的 Lotus Biscoff 饼干制成,有奶油或松脆的形式可供选择。 Lotus Biscoff 奶油饼干黄油具有无与伦比的稠度,但 Crunchy 版本采用 Lotus Biscoff 饼干钻头,带来额外的脆爽口美味。

description: Asana Foods Cinnamon Almond Butter Cinnabuddah is a spirited blend of organic roasted California Almond butter. As always, made fresh weekly in small batches at our commercial kitchen in Poway, Ca. We make about 50 new jars of cinnabuddah every week exclusively for our farmer’s market customer. It’s a very popular choice of moms and kids. Spread on fruits, vegetables, or toast as a light meal or after school snack. Cinnabuddah is made with three traditionally ayurvedic spices: cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg. All three spices are internally warming and excellent in aiding digestion. Asana Foods’ hand-crafted, artisan Almond Buddah is sweetened with coconut palm sugar. If you’re wondering if there’s really a difference between coconut palm sugar and regular table sugar and high fructose corn syrup, the answer is a definite, “YES!” Coconut palm sugar, unlike regular sugar does not contain empty calories; it naturally contains minerals such as potassium, calcium, zinc and iron. The coconut palm sugar that sweetens our gluten-free and organic almond butter also contains antioxidants and healthy natural fatty acids. Another benefit of Asana Foods’ organic almond butter is that the coconut palm sugar also naturally contains some fiber, which slows the rate at which blood sugar is raised, i.e. it’s lower on the glycemic index. The organic almonds in our Almond Buddah contain protein and natural fat, which also further slows the blood-sugar raising effect of the coconut palm sugar. And whether or not you believe it’s important to eat nuts that are organic, we believe that almonds are truly one food you should eat from certified organic sources–see below.** Roasted organic California Almonds ground into crunchy, sweet, delightful organic roasted almond butter with the added benefits of superfoods and healthier sweeteners! Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.


Justin's Nut Butters are made by using a one-of-a-kind grinding process that merges high-quality, naturally delicious ingredients with amazing taste, texture and nutrition. Packed with protein, our products are gluten-free, non-GMO, and contain 0g trans fat. Justin's is available in seven unique nut butter flavors to fuel your adventures.

Justin's Products

Our products are made with common sense and the highest quality. We think that selectively choosing fine, naturally delicious ingredients creates better tasting products. And we are certain your tastebuds will agree. Enjoy our naturally delicious, high-quality nut butters, nut butter snacks and organic peanut butter cups for their great taste, unique texture and convenient nutrition.

Nuts for Sustainability

At Justin’s, we strive to make more than delicious products; we hope to make a difference. To name just a few initiatives: Mindfully Sourced Ingredients, Pollinator Conservation, Hunger Relief Support, Organic and Rainforest Alliance Certified Cocoa...and many more! As we grow, so does our ability to give back. Join us.

One-of-a-Kind Grind

It all started with a jar. With the help of a simple food processor and the highest quality ingredients available, Justin revolutionized the world of nut butter to create products driven by a passion for delicious taste, unique texture and quality ingredients. First, he created them for his adventures. Now, he makes them for you.

First Ever Nut Butter Squeeze Pack

As the first nut butter brand to market protein-packed nut butters in single-serve squeeze packs, Justin’s provides a convenient source of nutrition for an active lifestyle. Available in 7 varieties, squeeze packs are perfect to enjoy on toast, fruit or right out of the pack. So, give your favorite nut butter a squeeze anytime, anywhere and on anything.

Peanut Butter Cup Perfection

What’s more perfect than peanut butter and chocolate? By blending his artisanal peanut butter with high quality chocolate, Justin created a better-for-you alternative to the conventional peanut butter cup. 100% organic, Rainforest Alliance-certified, gluten free and delicious. Yup, it’s how a peanut butter cup should taste. Available in dark, milk, or white chocolate, and miniature-sized if you're adventurous.

#fueledbyjustins

The story began in 2004 when Justin Gold, a lover of the active lifestyle, moved to Boulder, Colorado in his 20’s. In order to fuel his long bike rides, Justin embarked on a mission to create new varieties of nut butter that not only packed the protein, but also tasted great. He began crafting the very first batches of his now-famous, culinary nut butters in his home kitchen.

About the Company

Describe your product in 3 words.

Nuts. Fuel. Delicious.

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

Given that nut butter was a staple in my vegetarian diet, plain old peanut butter just wasn’t cutting it. I started grinding my own flavors and an assortment of experimental nut butters began to fill the cabinets. After weeks of hungry roommates stealing my tasty creations, I wrote my name on the jar and Justin's was born.

What makes your product special?

When I first started making nut butter, I didn’t overthink whether it was “smooth” or “crunchy”, I just made it because it tasted good, that is made with common sense ingredients and fills a lifestyle need. That’s what I continue to do today, focus on making naturally delicious products. It’s simple really. Simple, and delicious.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

It’s the creative and collaborative aspect of innovating that makes every day exciting. And, as we grow, we continue to invest in our commitment to corporate consciousness. We have the opportunity to truly be visionaries and develop great tasting products that people love.


Justin's Nut Butters are made by using a one-of-a-kind grinding process that merges high-quality, naturally delicious ingredients with amazing taste, texture and nutrition. Packed with protein, our products are gluten-free, non-GMO, and contain 0g trans fat. Justin's is available in seven unique nut butter flavors to fuel your adventures.

Culinary enthusiast Els Scheppers had the idea to create a creamy spread with the taste of Lotus Biscoff cookies. Scheppers entered the prime Belgian TV show “De Bedenkers – The Inventors” competing against 2,000 other entrants. 6 CERTIFIED USDA ORGANIC INGREDIENTS:
Raw Almonds, Maqui Berry, Camu Camu Berry, Lucuma, Coconut Sugar and Vanilla

Raw Almonds:
We soak our almonds in pink Himalayan salt crystals and dehydrated at a low temperature to insure the nutritional integrity and improve the digestibility of the almonds. Soaking also reduces the phytic acid, a substance that reduces your body’s ability to absorb minerals. We source only truly raw, non-irradiated and unpasteurized almonds from Spain

Maqui Berry (Ma-kee);
This small purple berry grows in the Patagonia region of Chile. We have chosen to blend this “JEM of the earth”, super berry in our organic sprouted almond spread for its extremely high antioxidant quality, specifically the well known anti aging flavonoids, anthocyanins, and its mild tart flavor

Camu Camu Berry (Ka-moo):
This “JEM of the earth” was harvested in Peru and was selected by our team because of its nutrient dense qualities. Camu is very high in Vitamin C and loaded with antioxidants, bioflavonoids, amino acids, and beta-carotene. Camu camu is a bitter berry so you may get that bitter kick at the end, go with it, and enjoy the benefits. Lucuma (Loo-ku-mah) This sweet fruit grown in Peru, Chile and Ecuador, is a great addition to our gourmet blend due to its low-glycemic yet nutrient-dense capacity. Iron, niacin, calcium, beta-carotene and fiber are a benefit of this fruit, as well as its yummy maple-like flavor

Coconut Sugar:
Coconut sugar is made from the sweet nectar of the coconut tree flower blossoms, coconut sugar is a pure and simple low-glycemic sweetener that provides the energy and mineral rich nutrition your body needs.

description:
Nikki’s Coconut Butter goal is to to create a healthy dessert-like treat that tastes amazing, but won't ruin your healthy diet. Each flavor of this delicious spread was crafted to show off the truly amazing nature of the superfood that is the coconut. Nikki's Coconut Butter can be enjoyed in many of the same ways that a peanut butter or almond butter could be consumed. This means you can pair it with fruit, add it to smoothies, or blend it into coffee. You can eat it on bread or crackers, or use it as a baking ingredient in desserts like cookies and brownies. With that said, most of our customers end up eating it one way. By the spoonful, straight from the jar.
If this is your first time buying we have a couple of tips for your first purchase
Instructions
All of our coconut butters are ground from the meat of the coconut, which means they contain coconut oil. Besides being one of the healthiest foods on the planet, coconut oil is also extremely sensitive to temperature. If your jar arrived above 75 degrees Fahrenheit, the coconut oil should become liquid and your coconut butter should have a nice creamy texture. The oil may have separated near the top, but just like a natural almond butter or peanut butter, you can either close the lid and shake the jar or you can mix it in with a spoon.
If your jar arrived below 75 degrees Fahrenheit, the coconut butter should be a solid texture. Sometimes, the coconut oil will separate first and then will solidify on top. Do not be alarmed. This is not mold. The coconut oil on top is one of the healthiest parts of the coconut butter and just needs to be reheated so it can be mixed back in. We recommend heating the jar above 80 degrees so that the oil becomes liquid and can be stirred in with the rest of the coconut butter. This can be done by microwaving the jar for 30-40 seconds.

description:

Villa Jerada's Amlou Butter blends California almonds with raw, organic honey along with an abundant amount of sustainably sourced Argan oil in our small batch making process.

Product Recipes

Harsha - Moroccan Scones with Almond Amlou

Harsha is a popular breakfast staple - a cross between a French galette and an American scone. It’s usually accompanied with Amlou (Argan Almond Butter), cream cheese or butter and honey – then accompied with mint tea or a nice latte.

It's easy to make and has so many variations to try (we love using anise or fennel seeds).

Recipe
350 grams of fine semolina
1 Tbsp of sugar
10 grams baking powder
100 grams of butter
1/2 cup milk
20 grams more semolina for dusting
Pinch of salt

In a mixing bowl, incorporate the semolina, sugar, salt and baking powder. Mix well.
Melt the butter and add without kneading to the flour mix until you obtain a sandy texture.
Pour the milk over and gently mix until it is absorbed. Let sit for 10 min.
With a rolling pin spread the dough to a 1/2 inch thick block. With a cutting disk cut little rounds.
Gather the remaining dough again and flatten with the rolling pin to get more pieces. Repeat until all dough is consumed.
Heat a cast iron skillet to med heat: once the pan is hot dust with semolina and start cooking the mini breads. Cook for 5 minutes on each side.

From the days of our humble beginnings in 2011 Villa Jerada has always and will always be a company committed to importing, distributing and making the highest quality pantry items of the Moroccan and Levantinian repertoire.

The food making aspect of our business remains the heartbeat of everything that we do because it gives us an opportunity to share our beautiful and colorful Moroccan experience through our love of food on a more personal level.
